_disclaimer: Fixed, reviewed explanation strings. Never generated text. Not legal advice.

explanations.strong-copyleft-in-proprietary: This package is under a strong-copyleft license (e.g. GPL/AGPL). Distributing it as part of a closed-source product can require releasing your own source code under the same terms. Flagged as CONFLICT for a proprietary project.
explanations.agpl-networked-use: This package is AGPL-licensed. AGPL's copyleft obligations extend to software offered over a network, not just distributed binaries — a stricter trigger than GPL. Flagged prominently regardless of project license.
explanations.weak-copyleft-review: This package is under a weak-copyleft license (e.g. LGPL/MPL). Obligations typically depend on whether you modify the package or merely link/import it dynamically. Flagged for REVIEW, not automatic CONFLICT.
explanations.noncommercial-conflict: This package's license restricts commercial use or requires special commercial terms (e.g. BUSL, SSPL, CC-BY-NC). Flagged as CONFLICT for any commercial project.
explanations.unknown-review: LicenseProof could not confidently identify this package's license. Unknown does not mean safe — flagged for manual REVIEW.
explanations.copyleft-in-permissive-project: This package is under a strong-copyleft license. Even though your project is permissively licensed, copyleft obligations can extend to how you distribute this specific dependency. Flagged for REVIEW.
explanations.gpl-apache-incompatibility: Apache-2.0 is known to be incompatible with GPL-2.0-only (patent clause conflicts). Flagged for REVIEW when a GPL-2.0-only project depends on an Apache-2.0 package.
explanations.pypi-metadata-classifier-disagreement: This PyPI package's declared license metadata disagrees with its Trove license classifiers - they resolve to different SPDX licenses. LicenseProof used the more specific metadata field (License-Expression or License) as the reported license, but the mismatch means the package's own metadata is internally inconsistent. Flagged for manual REVIEW to confirm the actual license.
